title: 第二十一章 我是天才？-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    闻言，爻雪缓缓摇头道：“不用，你身体不舒服就先去休息吧。”

    这人脸色还是苍白的，就算是自己再怎么缺人手，也还没有丧心病狂到让对方帮自己干活的地步。

    目前她的游戏商店虽然面积变大了，但实际上工作量并没有变化。

    不对，还是有变化的，她需要手动将冷藏区填满。

    不过，住在这里的人就算有厨房，让他们买生肉似乎也吃不了，总不能吃生肉吧。

    但那么大的一块区域空着不填满又有些不好看，爻雪有些纠结的皱了皱眉。

    好半晌之后，爻雪晃了晃脑袋，算了，不想了，她还是快点把那只觉醒药剂给制造出来吧。

    来到药剂制作间之后，里面的场景跟她预想中的很不一样。

    她以为这个药剂制作间会像童话里面女巫的房间一样，里面黑沉沉的，到处都布满了各种颜色的药剂，中间还架着一个大锅，锅里煮着颜色难看不知道是什么的药剂。

    结果，当她推开门，看到的就只是一个崭新的空间而已。

    崭新的墙壁，崭新的地板，崭新的工作台，工作台上空空如也，什么都没有。

    爻雪走近这间药剂制作间之后怔愣了许久，她的脑海里面是有关于觉醒药剂的制作方式没错，但是，这里什么工具都没有这让她如何制作啊。

    合着系统就给她单独开辟了一个房间，又对房间里面进行的简单的装修，除此之外，就在门口挂了个牌子，就成药剂制作间了？

    “系统，你老实告诉我，你真的不是盗版吗？”爻雪真诚地问道。

    【宿主不要胡思乱想，本系统可是正正经经的正牌系统。】

    听到系统这理不直气也壮的声音，爻雪更无语了，正牌系统这么废物？
    第(1/3)页

Hearing this, Yaoxue slowly shook her head and said, "No, if you don't feel well, just go and rest first."

This man’s face is still pale. Even if he is short of manpower, he is not crazy enough to ask the other party to do his work for him.

Although the area of ​​her game store has become larger, the actual workload has not changed.

No, there are still changes. She needs to fill the refrigerated area manually.

"However, even if the people living here have a kitchen, it seems that they can't eat raw meat if they buy it. They can't eat raw meat."

But such a large area was unfilled and unsightly, so Yaoxue frowned in confusion.

After a long while, Yaoxue shook her head, forget it, she didn’t want to think about it anymore, she’d better make the awakening potion quickly.

After arriving at the potion production room, the scene inside was very different from what she expected.

She thought that this potion making room would be like the witch's room in a fairy tale. It was dark inside and filled with potions of various colors. There was also a big pot in the middle, in which potions of unknown colors were boiled.

As a result, when she opened the door, all she saw was a brand new space.

Brand new walls, brand new floors, brand new workbench, the workbench is empty, nothing.

Yaoxue was stunned for a long time after approaching the potion making room. She had some ideas about how to make the awakening potion in her mind, but there were no tools here so how could she make it.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ out and simple decoration inside the room, besides hanging a sign at the door, turned it into a pharmacy making room?

"System, tell me honestly, are you really not a pirate?" Yaoxue asked sincerely.

【Host, please don’t think wildly, this system is a serious and genuine system.】

Hearing the system’s unreasonable and arrogant voice, Yaoxue was even more speechless. Is the genuine system such a waste?
